_doc: flow_cmp v2 windows (20260927, report staterecord-flow-gap.md section 1/4). One entry per comparable span of the reference.
ref_start / ref_end: HH:MM:SS.mmm inside the reference ring. The reference sequence of a task = its value at ref_start
(last entry at or before) followed by its entries in (ref_start, ref_end], repeats collapsed.
start_anchor: where the same span starts in the PORT file: the first entry of <task> whose value is not <leave> and that
follows an entry equal to <leave>; the window starts at that preceding entry. after_cmd: flow_cmp looks the command up in
script_result.json next to the port csv (flow_run v2) and only accepts an anchor after the command was sent.
The port sequence of a task = its value at the port window start followed by EVERY later entry (no end: prefix matching,
SIM keeps going where the real machine stopped on the alarm).
prod_anchor: production start (first time <task> reaches <reach>). A task that did not move in the reference window but moves
in the port between the start anchor and this anchor is an unexpected mover (a difference).
ring_cite: golden cpublic.h:237 #define MAX_Q_10 500 (entries kept per task)
